snippet.title: Marupoyo | Steam Next Fest Demo — Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
A little chick. A big adventure. 🐥✨

Discover Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure during Steam Next Fest, October 19–26, 2026!

Roll through colorful worlds, tackle playful challenges and meet your next little hero.

🎮 Play the free demo and ⭐ add Marupoyo to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4355110/

Tried the demo? Tell us what you think in the comments!

#Marupoyo #SteamNextFest #IndieGame
